Flow times and absolute observation times are real; integrated-rate horizons and exponential thresholds are finite nonnegative reals; waits are WithTop ℝ≥0. Rec=(ℝ≥0×(E×E))⊔Unit with distinct Borel tags. Ω=ℝ^ℕ; Hist=Fin(n+1)→Rec; HistNext=Fin(n+2)→Rec. b:Hist→ℝ≥0; G:Hist×ℝ→ℝ≥0∞; F:HistNext×ℝ→ℝ≥0∞. D takes ℝ≥0∞ values. Measures use the Borel/product structures; volume on ℝ is Lebesgue measure.

This is a restricted one-coordinate result, not equality of its global real U with the source extended T after stopping.

The six outer measurability conclusions and old-coordinate identity hold before choosing b. Then universal b and its measurability proof. Fiber bound is for every h∈Hist. No quantifier requires positive probability, realizability of h, b>a, bounded tests, or n>0.

The Borel cutoff is random only through evaluation on H; this is not a physical-time stopping theorem. Extended nonnegative tests are a justified stronger integration class for this bounded ingredient and do not assert the full path-functional source identity.

scopes.original: Fixed-reference evolution, elapsed hazard argument, absolute event times, post-jump versus pre-jump distinction, stopping at empty threshold sets, and full path horizon in A.7.
scopes.reconstructed: The fixed y,xRef and η,V enter the flow and rate; xRef,V enter reflection; y,xRef,z₀ and previous thresholds enter recursion and history. The cutoff b is chosen after n and may inspect every history coordinate including tags. All global append maps are defined on arbitrary histories and real times using truncated cumulative increment but raw flow time. The B-restricted formulas alone identify the actual appended record with the absolute append map. Restrictions are not renormalized. Null events and infinite test values are included by ENNReal integration. No source text, source theorem, implementation proof or independent review was consulted; no source-equivalence conclusion is offered.
scopes.evidence: On B, u-a>0 and the density evaluates the pre-bounce rate at Phi_(u-a)(last poststate); append then applies S. Previous records stay fixed. Stopped/default zero observations and negative auxiliary flow are not physical events. Null sets use unnormalized restriction. The no-event/infinite-wait mass is omitted from this strict finite restriction, not normalized away; no survival or endpoint atom conclusion is smuggled in.

constant_dependencies.original: Literal sqrt(eta) time scale, unit exponential thresholds, reflection coefficient two, initial time zero, alpha/beta/eta standing bounds; no new universal estimate constant for this identity.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: There are no existential or unspecified constants. α,β are the Hessian bound parameters; η is the fixed positive scale satisfying βη≤1. The literal constants include rate-one exponential law, initial cumulative time 0, zero defaults for missing tags/infinite waits, reflection factor 2, √η and its reciprocal, trigonometric time t without an extra frequency factor, exponential survival factor exp(−Λ), and upper mass bound 1. μ depends on n,y,xRef,z₀,V,η through H and on P; ν also depends on the chosen b. α and β constrain admissible data but do not occur explicitly in the displayed recursion/density formulas.
constant_dependencies.evidence: The rate, flow, density exponent and Exp(1) parameter match the primary source. Mass bound one comes from the actual probability law, not an extra normalization premise. No uniform cutoff bound, dimension-dependent constant, hidden regularity bound or higher derivative assumption occurs.

deltas.description: Absorbing stopped tag, time-zero observers, clipped raw thresholds and globally total append define explicit auxiliary semantics. They agree with source live finite recursion; B excludes stopped and nonpositive/infinite waits. The theorem never equates source infinite absolute time with its zero observer.

Coordinate-free finite-dimensional real inner-product carrier, including rank zero, and ENNReal joint tests are explicit elaborations/extensions. They introduce no extra analytic assumptions and do not replace the full-path target.

History-dependent Borel finite cutoffs and unnormalized history-event integrals expose the source iteration ingredient; the fixed-horizon case is a specialization. Neither positive conditioning probability nor random physical-time restart is asserted.

The infinite-wait/no-event atom and terminal survival are outside the strict restricted law; no mass is renormalized. Ordered iteration, final factor/path/count identification and full A.7 remain open. Existing actual-input nonaccumulation78/half-open coverage79 are upstream retained facts, not reopened or re-proved here.

Planned S91-T text includes a broader unweighted shear/inverse preservation theorem. This implementation realizes exactly the needed weighted coordinate law via fixed-history translation plus Tonelli; it does not separately close that broader theorem. Current lesson and proposed implementation mapping state this accurately.

source_coverage_audit.restatement_checked: Fixed arXiv2609.06905v1, 07 Sep 2026; perpetual non-exclusive arXiv distribution license. Local attributed restatement only.
V is globally C2; 0<alpha<=beta and alpha I<=Hess V(x)<=beta I for every x.
0<eta<=1/beta. Fixed y, reference x and initial phase; dimension is a finite Euclidean typing choice.
Center c=y-eta gradV(reference); gradient difference g(x)=gradV(x)-gradV(reference).
Literal harmonic flow, nonnegative rate sqrt(eta)[p dot g(x)]+, momentum reflection with zero-normal identity.
Independent Exp(1) sequence at fixed deterministic event depth; next unused coordinate, not an arbitrary random history or physical-time residual clock.
Next relative wait is the integrated-hazard threshold infimum on nonnegative time, with empty crossing infinity.
Finite next wait gives absolute Tnext=T+wait and post-bounce S(Phi_wait(z)); infinite wait terminates recursion.
Between events the path follows Phi, on the half-open pre-event time interval. Post-jump records determine subsequent segments.
Joint Borel flow/rate/bounce, hazard, threshold hitting and finite recursion are proved from continuity and rational-time tests.
A7 integrates over strict 0<t1<...<tn<T, with n=0 empty vector and empty product one.
Prescribed path is built by flowing and bouncing at the supplied strict times. Its pre-bounce rate is evaluated at t_j minus.
Iterate the conditional finite-event law with complete generated history and unused iid input to multiply finite-event density factors.
Convert relative waits to cumulative absolute event times, either one-step conditional translation or full triangular cumulative-sum substitution; alternatives, not simultaneous AND.
Identify constructed complete histories with prescribed-path states on strict ordered time support, and retain all earlier records.
Final no-next-event factor is exp(-hazard at duration T-Tn) on live finite histories; arbitrary Borel history-dependent duration is required.
Sum segment hazards including final duration to the integrated rate along the prescribed full path; finite point changes do not change Lebesgue integrals.

Identify exactly n events before horizon with first n finite ordered events and final survival; strict versus non-strict horizon boundary requires an internally proved no-finite-atom edge if equality is asserted.
Energy preservation and the finite rate cap imply nonexplosion from exponential sums; needed for exhaustive finite-count partition, not a one-step coordinate translation.
Bounded measurable path tests, simplex volume T^n/n!, and energy rate cap justify absolute convergence and signed expectation assembly.
For generalized nonnegative joint tests, require jointly Borel constructed histories/path observables and Tonelli; these are proof obligations, not extra source analytic assumptions.
Physical-time exponential residual memorylessness/Markov restart is a separate argument and is not a parent for fixed-depth finite-event iteration.
Path reversal, invariance and semigroup conclusions follow after A7 and are outside this preread target.
Terminal infinite-process limit/kernel/L2 claims are separate from finite deterministic history coordinate laws.
Unnormalized restricted measures handle null history events; stopped tags have no finite next density; live infinite waits supply missing finite-event mass and final survival.
Zero horizon/cutoff has empty positive-wait support. Rank zero or zero hazard has no positive finite-event component; n=0 remains a live deterministic initial record.
Finite horizon T is fixed, not random stopping time; a cutoff d(Hn) is random only by evaluating a fixed Borel finite-valued function on the whole past.
